summary_md: **Marc Hood ([@Official_Marc_H](https://x.com/Official_Marc_H/status/2115931696319098891))** presents **Hoodsfield**, an open local AI film studio on ComfyUI with Flux 3 images, MiniMax H3 video with sound, 3D shot blocking, lip sync, loops and a timeline editor, without cloud, keys or per-clip fees ([designn2future/hoodsfield-ai](https://github.com/designn2future/hoodsfield-ai)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - designn2future/hoodsfield-ai: Open-source, local-first AI film studio built on ComfyUI. Idea in, finished video out: script, images, video, lip-sync, timeline editing, upscaling and seamless study/lofi loops. Runs on your own GPU. Optional Claude assistant.
